column_description: A VARCHAR(20) primary key for support/feedback records (e.g., 'SUP001').
A SMALLINT number of technical issues reported (e.g., 2).
A SMALLINT how many support tickets the fan opened (e.g., 1).
A SMALLINT count of feedback submissions (e.g., 3).
An enum (SurveyParticipation_enum) describing survey participation (Never, Active, Occasional).
An enum (BetaTestingParticipation_enum) for beta test participation (Former, Yes, No).
A SMALLINT how many feature requests the fan submitted (e.g., 1).
A SMALLINT how many bug reports the fan submitted (e.g., 0).
A SMALLINT Net Promoter Score value (e.g., 9).
